‘Many lines of evidence now support the involvement of
two DNA polymerases, a and 8 (pols « and 5, respectively),
in the replication of eucaryotic and simian virus 40 (SV40)
chromosomes (5,19, 25). The two enzymes are distinguished
by their associated activities: pol « is in a complex with
primase (19), and pol 8 has an intrinsic 3’-to-S"-proofreading
Exonuclease (6, 25). pols « and & also differ in chromato-
graphic behavior (6), template primer preference (6), and
Antigenic properties (9, 17, 31). The nucleotide analogs
butyiphenyl-dGTP (BuPdGTP) and butylanilino-dATP are
potent inhibitors of pol a, whereas pol 6 is relatively resis-
fant to these compounds (18, 25). On the other hand, the
antibiotic aphidicolin inhibits both enzymes (25).
